pr.title: docs(fast-dev-os): install executor prompt pack + post-#675 doctrine cleanup
pr.body:
## Summary
- Installs `docs/03-reference/fast-dev-os/prompts/` (12 files) providing reusable, brand-safe prompts for multi-implementer routing (Codex, Claude Code, Gemini, Grok, Jules, GitHub Copilot) plus operator-side templates (master priming, role priming, implementation report, audit, acceptance decision).
- Adds a single-line link from `docs/03-reference/fast-dev-os/readme.md` to the new `prompts/readme.md` so the doctrine layer surfaces the prompt pack.
- Updates `docs/INDEX.md` and `docs/docs_index.yaml` for discoverability.

## Scope
Docs only. No runtime, service, test, compose, dependency, provider, or live extraction changes. Strict allowlist (17 paths).

## Boundary discipline
- Every prompt cites AGENTS.md §2 truth order by reference.
- Every implementer prompt includes the truth-posture statement: "Never invent paths, commands, branches, PRs, tests, capabilities, or tool behavior. Never say done/complete/no issues without evidence."
- Every prompt includes a "Lane" line referencing the L0–L6 risk taxonomy from `project-constitution.md`.
- No prompt embeds secrets, credentials, tokens, or user-specific paths.
- No prompt claims an `execution.agent` value outside the dopetask-canonical-spec.json enum (`gemini|codex|vibe|shell`). Claude Code / Grok / Jules / Copilot prompts route via the operator, not via schema fields.

## Validation
Include exact command outputs and exit codes for: jsonschema TP, docs_validator, docs_frontmatter_guard, docs-filename-hygiene check, grep for required textual invariants, anti-secret pattern grep (negative match), git diff --check.

## NOT_RUN
- Live provider calls
- Live extraction
- Docker startup
- Runtime service health checks
- Brand-voice quality-assurance agent pass (deferred; not configured for this repo)
- Schema extension to add claude_code/grok/jules/copilot to execution.agent enum (deferred to a future schema-extend TP)

## Residual Risks / UNKNOWNs
- RISK-PROMPT-DRIFT: prompts go stale as repo evolves; refresh policy is manual-per-major-runtime-change.
- RISK-SCHEMA: execution.agent enum doesn't include claude_code/grok/jules/copilot; prompts route those tools via operator narrative, not schema.
- RISK-LANE-DEFINITION: L0–L6 lanes are defined in project-constitution.md (this packet's parent TP-FDOS-004); if reviewer reads TP-FDOS-005 PR before TP-FDOS-004 merges, lane refs may look ungrounded.

@codex review

## Stacked PR note
This branch is stacked on `codex/dmx-fdos-004-authority-refresh` (PR #675). The diff below includes both packets until PR #675 merges to main; after merge, this PR's diff narrows to only the prompts/ additions.
